notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PtANuXJ.gif[/img]

[i]Note: This announcement is unrelated to Party Hard; its purpose is to give a shout-out to a different game from a small indie studio we know.[/i]

[b][h1]Hey there, partygoers! [/h1][/b]
[h3]It's a very unusual post for us to publish.[/h3]

Mutual support is something that indie game development has been famous for. The accumulative effort of the devs sharing each other's projects really helps get more eyes on their titles. Today, we wanted to shout out an upcoming game that has caught our eye recently. 

[i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] is a base-building survival game with an emphasis on story. It's set in a world that was completely flooded by a series of tsunamis, and the devastation's so great that all humans basically died. All but one! You play as that sole survivor, and you're stuck on a skyscraper roof, surrounded by the ocean. Well, not "stuck", actually,  since you're in for a good time there! You can grow crops, fish, build your own base... You can program robots to help you too! Besides, there's no other humans to annoy you by throwing loud parties! Perfect.


[h3][b]Check the game out and wishlist it:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658040/I_Am_Future_Cozy_Apocalypse_Survival/

notes.title: Introducing Working Hard: Steam devblog
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/1a6f710f23343b01512e437800835c0c18caacaf.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello, fawkes![/b][/h1]

For the past several months we have been working (hard, of course) on the Party Hard sequel, seeing no light of day. Our only food was bread and our only drink was water ("Dunkel" 4.7° lager, that is). Ignorant of what time of the year it was and whether or not battle royales were still popular, a band of code recluses called Pinokl (us) has been learning everything about elbow grease the [b]hard[/b] way. Until one day the man came around and wrote this: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/911fe01bb9464be80606b1b72a8ad57168c3496c.png[/img]

Should we say how these seven words and two question marks changed our worldview? After all those months of community silence, it was a one eye-opening experience indeed. [b]Therefore, it is time to straighten up and announce the new Steam community-exclusive developer blog: Working Hard![/b]

In WH, we will be–starting tomorrow–telling you about different features we added/are adding/will add to [i]Party Hard 2[/i], be it mechanics, characters or levels. All to keep you updated on the game's progress.

notes.title: Darius's Changelog: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/b27e14b72992131785e73e6344224bd69f2dfe37.gif[/img]

[h1] PartyHard v1.4.031; 17 Jul 2017, 2:59 a.m.[/h1]

[h1] [b] Dear Log![/b][/h1]

[b] It's Darius again. They stopped him. Finally. Should I say "fixed" instead? Nonetheless, he won't take a life anymore. Just listen to me and you will understand. [/b]

1. That police officer in the Porn Studio... (I'm talking about [i] High Crimes[/i] DLC level) So, you take out everyone—every single shnockered punk—, the victory over everlasting party insanity is within your reach; you are just about to leave... and but a second away that cop takes you down brutally. While he absolutely shouldn't! It wasn't even fair, to be completely frank. Well, the developers found out about this so called "software bug", took measures and fixed this issue [b] for good[/b]. Now this brute of a law employee only takes you [i] out[/i], and then you proceed to the next stage. Finally, some justice is done. [h1] PartyHard v1.4.030; 9 Jun 2017, 2:59 a.m.[/h1]

[h1] [b] Dear Log![/b][/h1]

[b] Crucial changes are being made to [i]Party Hard.[/i] It's been bugging me so much, I just can't take it out of my head. Got to tell someone. Or better write it down in my log. You, that is.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/de3f5c380d816666a5dce2245ca23f422e2db37c.jpg[/img]
[b] 1.[/b] An old main menu background (that really tied the game together) is gone. [u] Devs[/u] say they replaced it because it had caused the game to go all blackscreen sometimes. I believe them.
So, now we've got a new main menu background. It's still good old look out of the window but now it's like this:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/37b7d03d8d429d20d8cc3d888f1a99e1deb2507f.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/5761b9fd654f2d5eb7f765325ceb8bd531878c62.jpg[/img][/url]
[u] Devs[/u] say they have moved from one place where cars drive by all the time at low framerate to another where some guy tries to get some sleep at 3:00 a.m. As far as this statement goes, I doubt they're telling the truth. I smell some kind of... something.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] 2.[/b] Local co-op is now unavailable for those who haven't beat the tutorial. Sounds too cruel to me. It's like not allowing people who listen to Nickelback to reproduce. Wait...
---------------------------------------------------------------
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/ec6e342f213ba1e9115fc1cbedda2f0b6507a1e3.jpg[/img]
[b] 3.[/b] Fonts in main menu have been improved. Now their shadows display the way they should and don't switch layers, but... There had been something about the old buggy fonts that I just can't forget. Call me retrograde as much as you want.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] 4.[/b] Sometimes in order to quit the game you had to hover and click the "QUIT" button twice. Devs have fixed this to "save your precious time". I think they shouldn't have. Because it had taught you how not to be a puny quitter. But hey, who listens to me anyway...
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] Well, that's it for now, Dear Log. It's late and I need to get some sleep, but I just can't. That godd/\mn noise just won't let me sleep a freaking wink. Gotta do something about it.[/b]

notes.notes:

ːpartyknifeː[h1][b]NEW BACKGROUNDS[/b][/h1] 
[i] ([u]Where this new stuff is:[/u] [b] CONSTRUCTION / BACKGROUNDS[/b])[/i]
Dark Castle, Porn Studio, Skyscraper, Police Department. What do these levels have in common? Correct, Albert: they scroll. But as advanced as those maps may be... they are not[i] true[/i] scrolling levels until you can edit them. And [b] now [/b] you can—via the Workshop. 
----------------
[b] Dark Castle[/b]: 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/d797823bd79fac3882e84606fe41849f18bfb05e.gif[/img]
Deep in the Carpathians stands an old mysterious castle... When the sun dies over it, evil claims its reign inside. Vile creatures crawl out from under ancient tombstones to begin their blasphemous banquet. And it is[b] you[/b] who holds this banquet!
-----------------
[b] Porn Studio[/b]: 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7ab941a82f5f2e904dcff83bda802ffc7092a870.gif[/img]
Someone's trying to get some sleep? Them fools can forget it! Because you are filming some adult junk and raving out loud at the same time right around the bend. Studio is a perfect playground for you to have fun with your toys...ːpartylipsː
----------------
[b] Skyscraper[/b]: 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/8e629f4904323c8f56fa7baddb2b8e4700ca5753.gif[/img]
Throw a crazy party in a [i] Die Hard[/i] setting and then slaughter every human / animal / alien you've put in there. If you are scared of heights, let your friends tackle the issue.
-------------------
[b] Police Department[/b]: 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/f7c3be7dd6715a499ef59fdf117b8e63f643cf70.gif[/img]
Creating a prison to be locked in? Even Houdini couldn't have dreamt of such a luxury. Turning a police station into a bullfighting arena in not a pipe dream anymore.

ːpartypoliceː[h1][b]SURVEILLANCE CAMERAS[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/ddce20899cc715eb8e52e29143442fef1d147e38.gif[/img]
[i] ([u]Where this new stuff is:[/u] Surv. cameras: [b] FURNITURE / EQUIPMENT[/b]; Surv. guards: [b] PEOPLE / SPECIAL[/b])[/i]
Say you think [i] Party Hard[/i] isn't hard enough. [spoiler]sounds a bit far-fetched[/spoiler] Suit yourself and make it harder by placing survaillance cams all over the place. But, please, don't cry when security manhandles you.

ːpartymaskː[h1][b]DOORS, LOCKED WITH KEYS[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/124cbd8968cdbf9419284a2138f46904eee74cca.gif[/img]
[i] ([u]Where this new stuff is:[/u] Doors: [b] CONSTRUCTION / STRUCTURE[/b]; Keys: [b] TRAPS / ITEMS[/b])[/i]
Same here. Bring some logic to the table, make some doors actually [i] locked[/i] (authentic experience) and [strike] swallow [/strike] place the keys near an angry dog.

ːpartypillsː[h1][b]NEW WALLS, NEW TILE AND OTHER NEW STUFF[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7cb67c379fab9e4b1f55d71e539b02a373fb3c24.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/a6dc9365be7ce28433d3d1631fa53f2e10d72422.png[/img]
[i] ([u]Where this new stuff is:[/u] Walls: [b] CONSTRUCTION / WALLS[/b], Tile: [b] CONSTRUCTION / FLOOR[/b]) [/i]
Go old-school with chain-link fencing, honor Pink Floyd with a classic white brick wall, and create penitentiary vibe using a barbed wire barrier. 

ːpartydiskː[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/384c8af2d01e64bca553bc253045a52393cc54e9.gif[/img]
Once upon a time there was a wicked bug. It caused the game to crash when the brave party killer plugged in his faithful [b] controller[/b]. It has been fixed. End of the fairy tale. 

We've also fixed a bunch of other minor issues too so game's gotten even better. 

-----------------
[h1]Well, that's kinda it for the guide. We hope you'll have a lot of fun with the upgraded Workshop and with the game in general![/h1]

[b] Happy partying right there![/b]ːwaterː

notes.title: New character and improvements!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/b84a9947877161733526e8ce5e36b35889a34ae6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New playable character:[/b][/h1]

Hi, folks! We are planning to add a new free playable character to the game. But there is something special about him: you will decide who he is and what abilities he (or she) has!
We are constantly receiving ideas about new characters from you, so why won`t we give you a chance to fulfill your wishes? There is really an easy way to do this: just follow this discussion thread and write what character you want to see in the game next:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/356570/discussions/3/217691032449088455/
  
[h1][b]Also, we are working really hard on fixing issues and adding new stuff to the game, and today's list includes the following:[/b][/h1]

[h1]Mac\Linux DLC update[/h1]
We have updated High Crimes DLC for those systems, so anyone who had troubles downloading it can now freely suffer on new levels.

[h1]Cop (player) has been arrested for carrying bodies[/h1]
Yes, it's usually not a great idea to carry around dead bodies, it's not a "Swiss Army Man", you know. But when character abilities say he can carry bodies, we probably should let him do that. Fixed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7d4187d1341a0f67818200ab0a74e93d4edeb55e.png[/img]

[h1]Telephone events on all DLC levels[/h1]
DLC is tough as hell, we added some emergency numbers for the telephones in the High Crimes DLC to help some of you. Or to make things even worse... you never know.

[h1]Getting stuck in hiding places[/h1]
It seems that we made hiding places so comfortable that Darius refused to go out. We`ve put a few snakes and spiders inside so now he will likely go out when you ask him to.

[h1]Items pick up priority[/h1]
What would you choose: to find and pick up $100 or to go upstairs? While it`s an obvious decision for me and you, Darius thinks different. We talked a little bit and now he will prioritize to pick up items and then to use traps or doors.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/178b9b7d3916fdc1f0b2833a6319f4b47a54706a.png[/img]

[h1]Combo label positions[/h1]
While we like mysteries, combo score is something we really want to see. We moved it to proper positions on levels with scroll.

[h1]Cop Zombie fix[/h1]
After months and months of researches we finally found the zombie plague vaccine and decided to test it out on our policeman. And it seems to work perfectly. Cop cannot become a zombie from now on.

[h1]New explosion animations[/h1]
We changed the chemical composition of our grenades so now they explode more epic.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/6a7bc752bdc50adb38fbf801605f249b46ddb847.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/9c29ce64620b46d3da9284922816c70cfd6e27f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Security doesn't cause a busted screen in local co-op[/h1]
Did you know that inactivity causes your muscles to atrophy? Well, our security guards didn't know that, so we taught them a lesson. Now they are as deadly as they were before.

[h1]No 'Win' screen in local co-op when one of the players is dead[/h1]
We will win together or will not win at all... Well, that's not the case from now onwards. Fixed.

[h1]Finishing casino level[/h1]
With the great help of our dedicated players we found out what caused the never-ending issue on casino levels. It was a UFO. When they kidnapped people and were killed, counter didn`t change. We requested official commentary but all we got was "ayy lmao". Anyway, we fixed this issue.

[h1]Rebind keyboard controls[/h1]
We are all well informed that magic is restricted outside Hogwarts, so whoever disabled an option to rebind a keyboard after an update should really be aware of punishment. We brought it back.

[b]Do I need to remind you how much we appreciate your support and dedication to this game? I believe I do: thank you all! Now let`s see what character ideas you have![/b]

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/3b44be141acca6e8290b20c236fcc55d4bd708fe.png[/img]

We are constantly working to improve and fix issues in Party Hard to deliver you the best experience we can. This day's fix list includes the following issues:

- After the co-op update something strange happened to our dog companion... After killing another vampire he had been gone to his astral world to never come back again. It appears that we accidentally created too complex astral world, and Hellhound was just lost. With the help of our developers we managed to bring him back.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/944c686cc35c29094fb04c61cf4396d8a9894559.gif[/img]


- We added a small sign tweaks. Some of you complained that hide objects and signs looked exactly like escape doors, so we created a new one.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/00ee373ef7c0b0d92b3fa4151b0ea89c2a7aa74d.gif[/img] 


- There have been an issue when you would stuck in case a cop that was arresting you would suddenly (accidentally, of course, or of old age) die. While it could've been a big shock to Darius (he actually would be dumbfounded like this forever) we decided to fix this issue as well.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/96c07fee980eb50146b7afaece767f9042581c7b.png[/img] 


- Items on levels appear to stop displaying in black boxes/cases. It's usually a bad idea to keep such a valuable stuff in the open air, so we ordered a nice pack of new boxes and put them back in their places.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/f0d48b9c60b8c20d966393833ee5f5aedf0cde5b.png[/img]


We are continuing to investigate issues and fix them. The next update will bring more advanced local co-op improvements, but untill then - have a nice Party! ;)

notes.notes:
[img]http://imgur.com/iEzf7Lf.gif[/img]

Good news, everyone!

Party Hard is getting a huge upgrade soon. On Thursday the game will get the [i] Party Harder[/i] Update!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tbWinb3ZHlI
[h1]Base game changes[/h1]

- adding new levels
- adding local co-op
- new remastered OST
- new Twitch System that allows chat members to control individual NPCs
- "YouTuber" mode for the OST, meaning you can enable only "YouTube friendly" songs so you don't get copyright claims (we licensed the original songs)

[h1]New DLCs[/h1]

- paid DLC adds a continuation of the Party Hard killer's story, 10 years later!
- features a mini-campaign and additional large levels
- another DLC will allow you to purchase the OST (the remastered one we've recently made)

Tell your friends, tell your cat, tell your favorite streamer--Party Hard is gonna be partyin' harder! The update goes live on November 10th, this Thursday.

notes.title: Huge performance update is live
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QVOpx4S.png[/img]

[h1] Oh, hi![/h1] 

Yes, we are still working on Party Hard. This update makes sure we are able to add more content later and allows us to release on more platforms. 

[h1]Performance update[/h1]

A huge performance update for Party Hard is now live. It addresses multiple issues that impact framerate, and should result in a much smoother experience, especially in terms of loading times. 

It's a little-known fact that Party Hard has been developed in record time (only about 6 months), while it should've been an 18 month-development project. The game was being designed on the go with real-time feedback, and resulted in what we have now. We spent the last month on refactoring the game's code to enable it to run on more platforms. 

[h1] Kindle Fire TV release[/h1]

During the development we've had tons of help from [b] Amazon[/b], so the first non-desktop platform we're releasing on is Kindle Fire TV. The game is now available at http://www.amazon.com/tinyBuild-Party-Hard/dp/B01868JZDK/ref=sr_1_8?ie=UTF8&qid=1448035309&sr=8-8&keywords=party+hard 

[h1]Working on a Level Editor[/h1]

The team at Pinokl is hard at work on a Level Editor for Party Hard. Progress is being made, but no ETA yet.

[h1]We MAY or MAY NOT be working on a console version[/h1]

We can neither confirm nor deny the possibility of bringing Party Hard to consoles.

notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VzFdzQI.gif[/img]

[h1] [b] Hi, everyone![/b][/h1]

We are getting a ton of questions about updates, DLC, etc. I want to spend some time answering those questions.

[h1] Upcoming updates[/h1]

Alongside fixes, we will have significant content updates in the form of brand new events. Expect silliness like the UFO party on the GIF above, and other surprises. 

ETA for first content update is Monday.

[h1]Mac & Linux[/h1]

Working on these, ETA: soon.

[h1]DLC? Screw DLC![/h1]

No, we are not going to do paid DLC right now. I don't like it when you go to a Steam Store page and there are tons of these little upgrades you can do, it's confusing. If you want to give us more money, we might do a special Deluxe version or something like that, but we won't charge you for DLCs. 

You can help us by telling your friends about Party Hard instead. 

[h1]PAX Prime[/h1]

We are showcasing Party Hard at PAX Prime this weekend, and the first day reception is phenomenal. The game has great spectator sport appeal, with the crowd vouching for it. If you're at PAX and think of buying it, stop by our booth on the 6th floor!
